objects.description: [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has gathered system information of victim hosts through the use of common discovery commands to include `hostname`, `uname-a` and `printenv`.(Citation: Trend Micro TeamPCP MAY 2026) [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has also conducted system checks of the victim device to include enumerating the system type and the number of CPUs operating on victim host.(Citation: Hunt.io TeamPCP Toolkit MAY 2026)(Citation: Phoenix TeamPCP 20 MAY 2026)
